title: SYS-01 user and role report
what_it_shows: Two user accounts: the owner's administrator account and the irrigation dealer's technician account, created at the 2024 installation, with the irrigation technician role, which can start, stop and schedule irrigation and change setpoints at both sites; both accounts are active; the role catalog has three roles (administrator, irrigation technician, viewer), and only the administrator and irrigation technician roles can send irrigation commands; the vendor support access setting is on and has been on since installation; no record of a user list review

title: SYS-01 sign-in and MFA settings
what_it_shows: The owner's administrator account signs in with a password only; MFA by authenticator app is offered and turned off; the account is used from the laptop browser and from the SYS-01 app on the phone

title: SYS-01 activity log screen
what_it_shows: The activity log records sign-ins and irrigation commands (start, stop, schedule and setpoint changes) by user, on the vendor's platform, and can be filtered and exported; no record of a log review or log export

title: SYS-01 irrigation module and alarm settings
what_it_shows: The irrigation module controls the Home Farm pump controller (well pump drive, fertigation injector, freeze-protection sprinkler zone) and the River Field pivot panel through its cellular modem; schedules and setpoints are stored for both sites; freeze and pressure alarms go by text message to one phone number, the owner's; the freeze alarm fires when the field sensor reads at or below the set temperature; no second recipient or other alarm route is set up; well flow totals are recorded in SYS-01

title: SYS-01 records and export history
what_it_shows: SYS-01 holds the field, pesticide application, planting and harvest records, the yield maps and the well flow totals; the account's export history lists no data export

title: SYS-01 irrigation scheduling recommendation settings
what_it_shows: The vendor's scheduling model suggests run times from soil moisture, weather, crop stage and flow totals; recommendation mode is on and automatic application is off, so each suggested schedule waits for the owner's approval

title: FMIS vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, unmodified opinion, with one exception (late user-access removals at the vendor) reported as remediated; the system description states vendor-managed backups that are encrypted, integrity-checked and stored in a separate location, RPO 1 hour and RTO 8 hours, encryption at rest and in transit, and an encrypted command channel to field devices; the cellular device connectivity service that carries commands to pivot panels is a carved-out subservice organization; complementary user entity controls listed: MFA, user and role management, activity report review, mobile device protection, and securing field devices and networks

title: Irrigation dealer service agreement and installation handover notes
what_it_shows: The service agreement covers installation and support of the River Field pivot control panel, the Home Farm pump controller and the soil moisture probes; it contains no terms on security, such as MFA, named technicians, change notice or incident notice; the handover notes list the installed devices (pump controller with well pump drive, fertigation injector, freeze-protection zone and a local web page; pivot control panel with cellular modem; 12 soil moisture probes; 1 weather and freeze temperature sensor), explain day-to-day operation and the Hand-Off-Auto and local/remote switches, and say nothing about passwords or security settings; the dealer's technician account in SYS-01 was set up at installation

title: Home Farm walk-through
what_it_shows: Pump house and equipment barn padlocked, with no alarm on the pump house door; the pump controller panel has a Hand-Off-Auto switch and a local/remote selector; the owner showed how freeze protection is started by hand, and no written manual irrigation or freeze-night procedure is posted or kept; no surge protection on the pump controller; the outdoor access point bridges Wi-Fi to the pump house; signs with the farm name and address at the farm stand and on the U-pick check-in table; the customer Wi-Fi password is posted at the farm stand; produce is sold loose; the laptop is kept in the home office, where paper copies of program documents and the lease are filed; the freeze temperature sensor stands in the strawberry field

title: River Field walk-through
what_it_shows: Center pivot control panel in a locked cabinet, with a Hand-Off-Auto switch, a local/remote selector and a cellular modem; the River Field well; no buildings on the parcel

title: Booking platform admin security and account settings
what_it_shows: The admin account signs in with a password only; MFA is offered and turned off; the platform keeps an admin sign-in history, with no record of a review; about 1,800 customer accounts (user names or email addresses with passwords) are held by the vendor; prepayments are taken on the vendor's hosted payment page; vendor notices go to the account email, the owner's personal address, and no separate farm contact is registered

title: Booking platform sales, refund and customer reports
what_it_shows: U-pick reservation sales of about $70,000 a year, December to April, with about $4,000 on a typical in-season weekend; online pre-orders for watermelons and sweet corn with on-farm pickup, May to July; refunds issued on 2 U-pick weekends in the 2025-26 season; nearly all customer addresses are in Florida

title: Farm website and pre-order pages review
source_system: Farm website on the booking platform (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: The farm website, including the reservation and pre-order pages, shows the farm name and does not show the farm's complete business address

title: Card processor merchant agreement and card reader settings
source_system: Signed agreements folder; card reader app on the phone (SYS-10)
what_it_shows: The merchant terms require the farm to protect card data and to report suspected compromise; the processor-managed card reader pairs with the owner's phone and encrypts card data at the reader; booking prepayments go through the booking platform's hosted payment page; no self-assessment questionnaire has been requested; card numbers are not stored on or passed through farm-managed systems

title: Email marketing service account
what_it_shows: About 2,100 subscribers on the farm's email list; the list holds subscriber email addresses

title: Email and file account security page and storage review
what_it_shows: Consumer plan in the owner's name, also used for the owner's personal and family mail; MFA by text message, turned on in 2023 at the provider's prompt; the provider keeps a sign-in history; file version history is off and no backup is set up; file storage holds the scanned W-9s of the custom harvest operator and the River Field landowner, the customer export spreadsheet (names, emails, phone numbers, order history), program documents and the lease; invoices and payment requests from the custom operator, the landowner and suppliers arrive in this mailbox, as do vendor notices

title: Accounting SaaS and online banking security settings
what_it_shows: Accounting SaaS: MFA on; holds the W-9 data (names and Social Security numbers) of the custom harvest operator and the landowner, and bank account details; the tax preparer receives exports from it for Schedule F. Online banking: MFA required; the bank requires a one-time code before a new payee is added

title: Bank and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Farm bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the FMIS vendor, the booking platform vendor, the email marketing service, the accounting SaaS vendor, the consumer email and file plan, the internet provider and the cellular carrier; farm liability and crop insurance premiums; card processor deposits and fees; payments to the irrigation dealer, the custom harvest operator, the River Field landowner (cash rent) and the tax preparer; hourly payments to the IT technician; no payment for a cyber insurance policy

title: Vendor invoices and payment correspondence
what_it_shows: Irrigation dealer invoices for the 2024 installation, cost-shared under the NRCS contract, and for support since; a dealer service visit is booked for September 2026; IT technician invoices billed by the hour for laptop, phone and router help, with no recurring service or standing access; custom harvest operator invoices for digging and combining the 2025 peanuts with its own equipment and crew; payments to the custom operator, the landowner and suppliers are arranged by email

title: Laptop settings and contents review
what_it_shows: One administrator account, used by the owner and by family members; full-disk encryption on (on by default since purchase in 2025); automatic OS updates on and current; built-in antivirus on, with real-time protection and automatic updates; no backup set up; the browser stores the passwords for every farm account, and its password check flags the SYS-01 and booking platform passwords as reused; the downloads folder holds a copy of the customer export spreadsheet; yield monitor and as-applied files are copied from the tractor guidance display by USB stick; games and apps installed by family members; the browser history includes a public AI chatbot

title: Phone and tablet settings review
what_it_shows: Phone: passcode, device encryption on, automatic updates on; holds the SYS-01 app with irrigation control and alarm texts, the card reader app, the email account and its text-message codes. Tablet: passcode, device encryption on, automatic updates on; holds the drone ground-station app and field scouting notes

title: Router and Wi-Fi settings
what_it_shows: The router is supplied by the internet provider and was installed several years ago; one network carries the home office, the outdoor access point that bridges Wi-Fi to the pump house, and the farm-stand customer Wi-Fi network name; the connected-device list shows the laptop, phone, tablet, the pump controller and customer phones; Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a passphrase; the router firewall is on and no port is forwarded; the admin password in use is the one printed on the router label; the update history lists no firmware update since installation; the router keeps no traffic log

title: Sales by channel reports, 2023 to 2025
what_it_shows: Food sales averaged about $172,000 a year over 2023 to 2025; about 56% was sold directly to consumers at the U-pick and the farm stand and about 44% to the peanut buying point; the underlying sales records are held in the accounting SaaS and the booking platform

title: 2025 Schedule F (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files (prepared by the tax preparer)
what_it_shows: Gross farm receipts of about $180,000, with the preparer's sales worksheet showing peanuts about $80,000, U-pick strawberries about $70,000, and farm stand and pre-order sales about $30,000; no wages paid; custom hire paid to the harvest operator and cash rent to the River Field landowner; the business is a sole proprietorship; prepared from accounting SaaS exports

title: Peanut buying point settlement sheets, 2025 crop
what_it_shows: Dated settlement sheets from one buying point for the 2025 peanut deliveries, about $80,000 in total

title: Signed agreements folder: lease and W-9 forms
what_it_shows: Cash-rent lease of the River Field (about 100 acres) from an individual landowner; W-9 forms of the landowner and the custom harvest operator, both individuals, with names and Social Security numbers; scanned copies of both W-9s are in the file account and the paper lease is in the home office

title: USDA program and water use permit records
source_system: Paper files in the home office; agency portals
what_it_shows: Federal crop insurance policy on peanuts through a private crop insurance agent, with acreage and production reports filed with the agent; FSA farm records and acreage reports for both parcels; a 2024 NRCS conservation contract that cost-shared the Home Farm irrigation automation (pump controller, soil moisture probes, freeze sensor), written as a cost-share agreement; a water use permit from the regional water management district for the two wells; no federal procurement contract or subcontract is on file

title: Farm liability policy declarations
what_it_shows: Farm liability policy in force for 2026; the declarations page lists no cyber coverage or endorsement; the full policy form was requested from the agent

title: Drone registration and training records
source_system: FAA drone registration account; owner's certificate file
what_it_shows: The camera drone (RGB and multispectral) is registered with the FAA; the owner holds a remote pilot certificate with a small UAS rating and completed recurrent training in 2025; the drone carries a camera and no dispensing equipment; no cybersecurity course, certificate or reminder subscription appears in the owner's records

title: Search of the owner's files for security and exemption documents
source_system: Laptop; file account; email account; paper files
what_it_shows: Not found: a written security policy or procedure, a risk assessment or risk tolerance statement, a security role designation, an incident plan, incident log or contact list, a breach notice procedure, a written manual irrigation or freeze-night procedure, a recovery or contingency plan, a mutual-aid arrangement, a retention or disposal rule, a payment call-back rule, a vendor list or vendor oversight record, a device list, a network diagram, a record of where personal information is kept, a change log for irrigation settings, an AI use rule or review, or a written 2026 annual review and verification of qualified exemption eligibility; no copy of SYS-01, booking or accounting records outside those systems; no FDA food facility registration

title: AI yield trial account and forecast history
what_it_shows: Trial account opened for the 2025-26 strawberry season; 18 weekly drone image uploads from December 2025 to April 2026; weekend yield forecasts by block, with picked pounds from the farm stand scale entered for comparison; the owner states the forecasts set the number of reservation slots opened each weekend; no integration with SYS-01 is set up

title: AI yield vendor terms, as accepted
source_system: AI yield vendor website; trial account (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Click-through trial terms, accepted at sign-up, let the vendor use uploaded farm imagery and yield data to improve its models

title: Public chatbot account history
source_system: Public generative AI chatbot (consumer account, laptop browser)
what_it_shows: Consumer account in the owner's name, used from the laptop browser; the conversation history covers drafts of customer emails and website text, with prices and U-pick hours

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: Owner-operator's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT technician
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems, vendors and season involved, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; on a freeze night the sprinklers must be running within about 2 hours of the alarm; peanuts tolerate about 2 days without irrigation; the owner is the only person who performs or authorizes each function and the only alarm recipient

title: Risk walk-through of the laptop, router, pump house and SaaS accounts
what_it_shows: Where farm data and credentials sit day to day (SYS-01, the booking platform, the file account, the laptop browser and downloads folder, the phone); family use of the laptop; payments arranged by email; USB transfers from the tractor display and the drone; who can send irrigation commands (the owner, the dealer technician account, vendor support access); the single freeze alarm path; field electronics exposed to lightning, with no surge protection

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-operator's written answers to the CSF 2.0, Produce Safety Rule and Fla. Stat. 501.171 questions, checked on screen with the IT technician
what_it_shows: Stakeholders' security expectations are not written down; there is no security budget; risk decisions are made by the owner without a written approach; vendors were chosen on price and features, and the AI trial terms were not read before use; no threat information is received or shared; devices are bought from the dealer and official app stores with no further checks; no assessment was made before the AI trial or the dealer installation; the pump controller and pivot panel firmware have not been checked since installation in 2024; incidents would be handled as they arise; manual freeze start has never been rehearsed with anyone else; a 2025 pivot alarm outage left no notes; the pump house is checked on daily rounds; the owner would keep irrigating by hand during an outage; the owner did not know the farm is a covered entity under Fla. Stat. 501.171; the farm publishes and develops no software, and the dealer programs the controllers; the owner was trained by the dealer to operate the irrigation controls and not on their security settings; bandwidth needs are small, with the phone hotspot as the fallback

title: Sample of 10 sales records
source_system: Booking platform and card reader reports; accounting SaaS (SYS-09); buying point settlement sheets
what_it_shows: Each of the 10 sampled sales records is a dated system record or a dated settlement sheet showing the amount and the channel or buyer, and each traced to an entry in the accounting SaaS

title: AI yield trial accuracy review
source_system: AI yield prediction account (SYS-08); farm stand scale totals; booking platform refunds
what_it_shows: Weekend forecasts compared with picked pounds for the 16 open weekends of the 2025-26 season: mean absolute percentage error 22%; 12% in clear weeks; over-forecasts of 30% or more in the 5 weekends after rain or heavy cloud; refunds on 2 overbooked weekends; the 2 weekends closed for cold weather are excluded

title: Control assessment: Remote access review
source_system: SYS-01 user list and support access setting; dealer service agreement; router port check from outside the network; owner self-review
what_it_shows: One remote path to the pump and pivot exists: SYS-01 over the vendor's connection, with the pivot on the vendor's cellular channel; the port check from outside found no inbound port open on the router; the dealer technician account has full irrigation control all year, with no usage rules or written guidance, and was never authorized by the owner for ongoing use; the vendor support access setting is on permanently

title: Control assessment: Backup review
source_system: FMIS vendor SOC 2 report; laptop and file account settings; SYS-01 export history; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The SaaS vendors back up their own platforms, and the FMIS vendor's SOC 2 report shows encrypted backups, integrity checks and separate storage with no exceptions; the laptop and the cloud files have no backup; SYS-01 and booking sales records have never been exported to a farm-held copy; security documents and program records are kept only in the consumer file account with version history off

title: Control assessment: MFA sign-in test
source_system: SYS-01, booking, email, accounting and bank account security pages; sign-in tests from a new browser
what_it_shows: Email, online banking and the accounting SaaS required a second factor; the SYS-01 administrator account and the booking admin account signed in with a password only

title: Control assessment: Password and default credential test
source_system: Laptop browser password store (count only); router and pump controller login pages; customer Wi-Fi sign; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The pump controller's local web page accepted the manufacturer's default password from the laptop on the home network, and the router admin page accepted its factory password; the SYS-01 and booking passwords are the same 10-character word and number pair; every farm password is saved in the browser of the laptop account that family members also use; no password manager, and no steps for a lost phone, a compromised password, or the end of a service relationship; the laptop, phone and tablet encrypt stored credentials; vendors verify identity when accounts are created and the owner sets up every farm credential; the only shared credential is the customer Wi-Fi password, changed at the start of each U-pick season

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting self-review
source_system: Contact lists; vendor notice settings; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No reporting time is defined; vendor notices go to the personal mailbox mixed with family mail; there is no list of whom to notify (counsel, vendors, affected individuals, the Florida Department of Legal Affairs)

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment identifies 15 threat events with sources and vulnerabilities, including the irrigation OT; it rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2, using crop loss and records loss as impact; it considers impact on individuals for W-9 data and customer accounts; it takes its business view from the BIA and is documented in the register and report; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: Vendor review
source_system: Vendor terms; dealer service agreement; FMIS vendor SOC 2 report; vendor account contact settings; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The dealer agreement has no security requirements, and the AI yield vendor is on click-through terms that allow secondary use of farm data; no required controls are defined for vendors; no vendor list or oversight steps are documented; vendors that hold personal information have no farm breach contact registered; SYS-01 roles are set for the owner and the dealer, and the FMIS vendor's customer responsibilities are listed in its SOC 2 report; only the FMIS vendor is checked (SOC 2 review on 2026-07-15)

title: Control assessment: Network test
source_system: Router settings and connected-device list; ping and web test from a phone on the customer Wi-Fi to the pump controller; router port check
what_it_shows: A phone on the customer Wi-Fi reached the pump controller's web page; the customer Wi-Fi, the laptop and the pump controller share one network, with no control or monitoring between them; the router blocks inbound connections, has no port forwards and keeps no traffic log; the farm connects to the internet only through the provider router, and the pivot only through the vendor cellular service; the owner changed the customer Wi-Fi password and took down the posted sign the same day

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection test
source_system: Antivirus status page; standard antivirus test file downloaded and copied from a USB stick
what_it_shows: The built-in antivirus detected the test file on download and when the USB stick was opened, quarantined and removed it, and showed an alert on the laptop; signature updates install automatically (last update the same day); scheduled scans and real-time protection for downloads, attachments and removable media are on; no false positives recorded
